actress.alt: An actress in a dark velvet dress stands with hands on hips in a spotlight on a theatre stage.

anger.alt: A bearded man with wild hair and glasses shouts angrily at the camera.

busy.alt: A crowded market square with auto rickshaws, stalls and many people seen from above.

closed.alt: Old dark wooden barn doors are shut with metal latches and padlocks.

cold.alt: Long icicles hang from a snow-covered wooden roof edge in winter.

cooks.alt: A chef in a white jacket cooks in a steaming frying pan on a steel kitchen counter.

decorate.alt: A woman in a checked shirt paints a grey wall with a paint roller.

delicious.alt: A plate of roast meat with carrots, asparagus and sauce on a white plate.

dirty.alt: Two muddy green shoes stand in wet soil with mud caked on the soles.

drain.alt: Water drains through a metal colander as a hand tips a pan of cooked prawns.

drives.alt: A woman in a white shirt drives a car with both hands on the steering wheel.

earthquake.alt: A long crack runs across a pink plastered wall.
